title: orchis militaris subsp. simia
intro: Orchis militaris subsp. simia, commonly known as the monkey orchid, is a plant species belonging to the Orchidaceae family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, which include improving cardiovascular health, reducing inflammation, and enhancing immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as bergenin, orchinol, and flavonoids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Orchis militaris subsp. simia have been shown to have potential applications in the treatment of various diseases, including cardiovascular disorders, cancer, and neurodegenerative diseases.
